exposure: Preoperative chemotherapy (in a subset of the TDRS group)
cohort: 128 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) at an unspecified hospital between January 2006 and June 2014
finding: TDRS was found to be a safer and more effective treatment for CSP compared to UAE, with faster recovery times, and the outcomes were not significantly different between patients who did and did not receive preoperative chemotherapy.
gest_age: Gestational age at diagnosis was analyzed as a factor potentially related to postoperative recovery.
